text:
claire: quick sync on saved per-route views + model filters. Do we store routing inline or resolve at runtime? reproducibility vs rollout fragility. tagging @oz @mike

oz: i'd prefer runtime resolve by default. infra changes frequently; inline pins surprise teams. but we should capture a reproducible snapshot somewhere.

mike: agree. option: store a tiny snapshot blob (resolved_region/tier + cost_estimate) plus a "resolve_policy" that controls behavior: hard|soft|snapshot-first. UI shows snapshot and live-resolve with a toggle.

ana: telemetry note: always emit both snapshot and resolved routing on apply. fields: saved_view_applied -> [saved_view_id, user_id, snapshot_routing, resolved_routing, model_rev, sample_rate]. we need that to debug output deltas.

claire: API sketch for saved object (DB row stores stringified fields):
```json
{
  "v": "1",
  "route_id": "route-77",
  "model_filter": "open-13b@rev-2025-11",
  "filters": "status:error",
  "snapshot": "eu-west-1/dedicated-small|tokens=900|latency_ms=130",
  "resolve_policy": "soft",
  "sampling_hint": "0.05"
}
```
claire: snapshot stored as a compact string to avoid schema churn.

oz: migration plan: read old objects, call resolver to synthesize snapshot, write back with policy=soft. do this slowly via background job to avoid spikes. expose both v1/v2 in read API for 2 weeks.

mike: UX: show a banner when live resolution != snapshot: "Saved snapshot: eu-west-1/dedicated-small. Current resolved: us-west-2/burst. Use snapshot / Use live". default to snapshot for reproducibility but warn about cost/latency. add tiny cost delta next to route badge.

ana: sampling: store sampling_owner = route|view|global and sampling_rate as float 0..1. important for telemetry aggregation.

claire: failure modes: if snapshot references missing capacity, resolver should return FALLBACK_NOT_FOUND and apply should fall back according to policy: [snapshot->route-default->cheapest-compatible]. show clear error with action buttons.

deploy-bot: queued: saved-view-migration job @2801234585 (job/9981).

oz: we'll gate live-resolve preview behind feature flag and A/B test 10% first to measure latencies.

mike: I'll mock the toggle UI + banner copy and drop it in this thread.

claire: ok owners: oz -> resolver & migration orchestration; mike -> UI mock; ana -> telemetry schema; claire -> API contract and rollout checklist. capturing decisions in INF-3110. thanks all.
